# Poliahu walks into a education, research & knowledge firm

Walk into any education, research & knowledge outfit and watch for ten minutes. You will see a very old act performed with newer props. The act has a name. It is **Poliahu**.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Origins.** Poliahu appears in polynesian tradition as snow, mauna kea.  The name's meaning, "Cloaked bosom", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Poliahu in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.
